title: HLSE Pattern Registry
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json --list-patterns` — the authoritative, machine-readable registry of all stable HLSE-* pattern_id tokens for SIEM/SOAR routing.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this registry.

count.description: Number of tokens in the patterns array.

id.description: Stable append-only SIEM/SOAR routing token. Once assigned, never changes or is reworded.

kind.description: JSON verdict kind that can emit this pattern_id.

description.description: Human-readable description of the attack pattern or threat (for documentation; subject to rewording without notice).

patterns.description: Array of all stable pattern tokens, ordered by kind and pattern name.
